changes.title: New section: partnerships, the business case made in public
changes.summary: A new partnerships section states its method (public material only, evidence not pitch, the fit stated precisely, what is not public marked) and carries a first case, a proposed partnership with UK Sovereign AI.

changes.title: The Sovereign AI case gets its anchoring, from the founder's own memo
changes.summary: Adds a first-person UK anchoring section (thirty years in the UK, one UK exit, a UK-registered trading company) and the argument that there is no sovereign AI without open source; the About page gets the same facts in one row.

changes.title: The Sovereign AI page says what it is in its title
changes.summary: Retitled 'A proposed partnership between sgit.ai, RiskMandate.ai and UK Sovereign AI' so a reader arriving from a forwarded link knows it is a proposal from sgit.ai's side.

changes.title: The thirty-second vault, and the first business plan published for somebody else to run
changes.summary: Publishes Agent as Webmaster as a vault with its read key and adds 'Business plans to build on' to the startups section; the publish found two CLI transport bugs, which the log says were fixed in the CLI repository with a pinning test.

changes.title: The DSIT AI Risk Toolkit page starts with the reader's decision, and plays the deck
changes.summary: Rebuilt from a brief: the page now opens on the use-case journey with an eight-slide deck read live from the vault, keeps the journey, reference edition and two graphs' figures apart, states the licences, and improves the deck viewer's accessibility.

changes.title: Agent as Webmaster, a business plan published as a vault
changes.summary: A business plan for giving small businesses a website they change by asking an AI agent, with prices marked as starting hypotheses, a unit-economics calculator, four mock-up sites, an app declaring no permissions, and an audit that found nothing.

changes.title: Partnerships, argued in the open, sgit.ai
changes.summary: Index of partnership cases between sgit.ai, RiskMandate.ai and organisations they would like to work with, each built from public material and written to be forwarded.

changes.title: A proposed partnership between sgit.ai, RiskMandate.ai and UK Sovereign AI
changes.summary: A proposal from sgit.ai's side, with no conversation held with the fund: maps the fund's trust, safety and assurance frontier and its safe-agent-adoption challenge area to published vaults and proposes three partnership shapes.

changes.title: The logo as EPS, for a printer who asks for one
